import pandas as pd

def compute_missingness(input_path, output_report_path, output_selected_path):
    # Read the input CSV file
    df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

    # Calculate missingness for each indicator column
    missingness = {}
    for column in df.columns:
        if column in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']:
            continue  # Skip non-indicator columns
        missing_count = df[column].isna().sum()
        missing_rate = missing_count / len(df)
        missingness[column] = {
            'missing_count': missing_count,
            'missing_rate': missing_rate,
            'kept': missing_rate <= 0.30
        }

    # Create the missingness report DataFrame
    report_df = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(missingness, orient='index')
    report_df.index.name = 'indicator'
    report_df = report_df.reset_index()
    report_df.to_csv(output_report_path, index=False, quoting=pd.io.common.csv.QUOTE_ALL)

    # Select columns with missing_rate <= 0.30
    selected_columns = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + [col for col in df.columns if missingness[col]['kept']]
    selected_df = df[selected_columns]
    selected_df.to_csv(output_selected_path, index=False, quoting=pd.io.common.csv.QUOTE_ALL)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    input_path = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
    output_report_path = 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv'
    output_selected_path = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'
    compute_missingness(input_path, output_report_path, output_selected_path)
